status: Original edge-assessment dictionary retained for provenance; the operational grading boundary for C02 is recorded in full_ratings.json and Table S1a.

constructs.name: Familial and genetic background
constructs.scope: Inherited parental/offspring liability and stable shared familial background.
constructs.coarse_time: Parental inherited background precedes pregnancy; offspring genotype is established at conception. Stable family influences are antecedent.
constructs.boundaries: Distinguish parental from offspring genotype when discussing maternal history. Sibling comparison is an analytic design, not the node. This node is not all later household changes or C02/C03 social position.
original_components: Inherited parental and offspring genetic background
Drug-metabolism genotype as a candidate mechanistic component

constructs.name: Sociodemographic and family characteristics
constructs.scope: Maternal age, household/partner structure, social-group/migration context, and child sex as explicitly distinct components.
constructs.coarse_time: Maternal demographic history and pregnancy-relevant family context; child sex established early in development. Components have different histories.
constructs.boundaries: Restore the original component dictionary. Name the component supporting a direction. Current maternal age cannot act backward on completed reproductive history. An incoming arrow to household state does not cause child sex.
original_components: Child sex as a distinct offspring component

constructs.name: Socioeconomic position
constructs.scope: Education completed and material resources/income/employment established before target X. Distinguish components, without moving between their past and future versions.
constructs.coarse_time: Fixed relative to the selected prenatal exposure window as specified in scope; no pair-specific time changes.
constructs.boundaries: Do not use post-treatment or post-child-outcome changes to justify incoming effects.
original_components: Education completed before target medication use
Pre-use material resources, income and employment

constructs.name: Geographical and calendar context
constructs.scope: Geographic residence/exposure setting and calendar context relevant to the target pregnancy and follow-up environment.
constructs.coarse_time: Pregnancy-relevant location and calendar setting precede later endpoint ascertainment. Residence may change; calendar time is an index.
constructs.boundaries: A personal event cannot cause calendar time. Residence changes must be actual, not healthcare-site choice or sample composition. Do not silently import a childhood residence history.
original_components: Geographic context before target medication use
Calendar context of the target pregnancy/exposure period

constructs.name: Established maternal neuropsychiatric health
constructs.scope: Established maternal neurodevelopmental or psychiatric conditions and history.
constructs.coarse_time: Established before the prenatal use it may influence. Onset may substantially predate recording.
constructs.boundaries: Exclude a new reaction to the child outcome and temporary post-dose symptoms. Do not infer a universal ordering against socioeconomic, physical-health or reproductive history.

constructs.name: Maternal physical and metabolic health
constructs.scope: Pre-existing chronic physical/metabolic conditions and antecedent adiposity/BMI relevant to pregnancy.
constructs.coarse_time: Chronic or antecedent states before the use they may influence; condition onset and BMI measurement can differ.
constructs.boundaries: Separate named disease components and BMI. Current-pregnancy complications belong to C13. Do not import drug-induced new disease into this established-health node.
original_components: Pre-existing chronic physical or metabolic disease
BMI or adiposity before target exposure

constructs.name: Maternal indications and symptoms
constructs.scope: Maternal infection, fever, pain or headache present before target X; distinguish the actual indication components.
constructs.coarse_time: Fixed relative to the selected prenatal exposure window as specified in scope; no pair-specific time changes.
constructs.boundaries: Post-X symptom relief or new symptoms are outside this node. No universal ordering relative to C10 or C11 is imposed.

constructs.name: Reproductive and prior obstetric history
constructs.scope: Completed prior pregnancies, parity and specific previous obstetric outcomes.
constructs.boundaries: Exclude current pregnancy complications and events. Distinguish historical age/social states from age or household state measured in the present pregnancy.

constructs.name: Psychosocial conditions and health behaviors
constructs.scope: Maternal smoking, alcohol, other substance use and psychosocial stress before target X.
constructs.coarse_time: Fixed relative to the selected prenatal exposure window as specified in scope; no pair-specific time changes.
constructs.boundaries: No post-X behavior change or post-child-outcome reaction. Do not substitute healthcare literacy or all health preferences.

constructs.name: Maternal healthcare seeking and use
constructs.scope: Actual maternal healthcare seeking and contacts before target X, including preventive and symptom-driven contacts. This includes pregnancy-relevant prior utilization.
constructs.coarse_time: Fixed relative to the selected prenatal exposure window as specified in scope; no pair-specific time changes.
constructs.boundaries: Exclude post-X contacts and child diagnostic contacts. Actual contacts are not identical to healthcare access, income, health literacy or a latent stable family care propensity. Do not assume either C10<C11 or C11<C10 globally.

constructs.name: Other medications and treatments
constructs.scope: Other medication classes and treatments before target X; name the class or treatment component.
constructs.coarse_time: Fixed relative to the selected prenatal exposure window as specified in scope; no pair-specific time changes.
constructs.boundaries: Exclude treatments started after X and changes after child diagnosis. Order relative to C10 or C07 is not imposed; competing episodes cannot be swapped to support two directions.

constructs.name: Environmental and occupational exposures
constructs.scope: Actual environmental or occupational agents, such as pollutants, lead, pesticides or physical agents.
constructs.coarse_time: Exposure histories relevant to the maternal preconception/prenatal period.
constructs.boundaries: Name a relevant actual agent/process. Do not substitute job class, residence, income or workplace culture for actual exposure. Offspring postnatal exposure is a different scope.

constructs.name: Current-pregnancy obstetric and perinatal health
constructs.scope: Current-pregnancy complications, gestational age at delivery, birthweight and delivery mode as distinct components.
constructs.coarse_time: Some complications can precede prenatal use; others follow use; birth outcomes occur at delivery. All precede postnatal child processes.
constructs.boundaries: No universal post-X restriction. Name the component and relative stage. Opposite directions may require pre-use complication versus subsequent perinatal components. Do not treat the whole construct as one observed baseline covariate.

constructs.name: Infant feeding and breastfeeding
constructs.scope: Actual early postnatal feeding/breastfeeding practices and their relevant course.
constructs.coarse_time: After delivery, before the selected later endpoint; may overlap early childhood health and developmental manifestations.
constructs.boundaries: No universal C14<C15<C16 order. Distinguish initial feeding from later duration/change. A causal relation must use compatible component periods.
original_components: Feeding status in a fixed early-infant window
Breastfeeding in that same early-infant window

constructs.name: Early childhood physical and immune health
constructs.scope: Early childhood physical illness, immune-related conditions or relevant biological states, with named components where needed.
constructs.coarse_time: After birth and before the selected later endpoint, potentially overlapping feeding and developmental manifestations.
constructs.boundaries: No universal order against C14/C16. Ordinary minor infections cannot stand in for severe CNS injury. Distinguish actual health from its detection or healthcare utilization.
original_components: Microbiome-related measures as a distinct component
constructs.construct_label: Early childhood physical and immune health

constructs.name: Early neurodevelopmental and regulatory phenotypes
constructs.scope: Early offspring developmental/regulatory manifestations distinct from the later selected recorded outcome.
constructs.coarse_time: After birth and before the separate later endpoint; onset and recognition/measurement may differ.
constructs.boundaries: No forced post-C15 window. If the C16 measure is the study endpoint, map to Y. Effects on recording are distinct from causing latent ASD/ADHD onset.

constructs.name: Biological and pharmacological response processes
constructs.scope: Candidate biological/pharmacological responses following target X during pregnancy; preserve distinct mechanism branches.
constructs.coarse_time: Fixed relative to the selected prenatal exposure window as specified in scope; no pair-specific time changes.
constructs.boundaries: No baseline biological state or effect on later X. These are hypothetical, non-exhaustive mediators; component existence and effects need support.
